profile.summary: Driven Computer Engineering student with a strong focus on DevOps, cloud infrastructure and backend automation. Proficient in Linux, Python, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and modern CI/CD tooling like GitHub Actions and Terraform. Experienced in building automated deployment pipelines, configuring network security, and implementing system monitoring and logging solutions. Eager to contribute practical infrastructure and engineering expertise to an innovative tech team.

projects.title: Automated CI/CD Pipeline for a Dockerized App

projects.title: AWS Infrastructure with Terraform

projects.title: Monitoring Stack with Prometheus and Grafana
projects.description: Docker Compose stack that collects host and container metrics, shows them on Grafana dashboards and sends alerts when thresholds are crossed.
